REGENERATE, DO NOT ACCEPT. Rebuild both curve instances from master seed 2301 and regenerate a declared subset of the CAL-1 replicate draws from the recorded streams, and report agreement or disagreement with a concrete number rather than a verdict word alone.

Confirm CAL-1 used 200 INDEPENDENT DISJOINT replicate pairs per bit size, that is 400 independent random factor bases per cell, and NOT a chained pool - the exact level of THR-EQD-1 depends on that independence and a chained pool would break exchangeability.

Recompute the CAL-2 detection rate at every delta on the frozen ladder and evaluate the CERT-EQD-1 predicate yourself, and say whether a certified delta exists at both bit sizes or whether CAL-STOP-1 is met.

Report explicitly whether any statistic has a DEGENERATE null distribution under CAL-STOP-1 second_stop_leg - zero variance, an identically zero value, or a threshold the largest-delta plant cannot exceed - and name it with its measured reason. Do NOT exclude it yourself; that is TASK-20260801-023's pre-declared call.
Confirm every recorded e_1 and e_2 lies in [0, p) and that every OBJ-NULL-RFB admissible-support fraction is exactly 1.0.
Confirm the calibration package contains NO factorization, NO smoothness statistic, NO Dickman evaluation, NO search arm, NO timing decision variable, NO cost identity and NO R.
Confirm manifest.yaml is present with its required fields and that command.txt, environment.json, stdout.log, stderr.log and raw-result.json exist beside it.

TREAT NO CALIBRATION NUMBER AS EVIDENCE ABOUT ANY HYPOTHESIS. RUN-EQD-001-calib is expressly non-evidential about H-EQD-001, HEUR-DS-1 and H-SMTH-001 in either direction. Your report is about the instrument and may not state or imply a disposition about any hypothesis.
Do NOT interpret the calibration, do NOT freeze or propose any threshold, do NOT classify anything against a reading rule that does not yet exist, and do NOT state a disposition.

Do not audit whether the calibration TUNED the experiment - that is the named ATS-1 duty of the reviewer at TASK-20260801-025 and it is deliberately assigned to a different session. Your question is whether the calibration is SOUND.
Timeouts and crashes are infrastructure, never mathematical negatives (AGENTS.md rule 5).

handoff.objective: Validate the integrity of the RUN-EQD-001-calib package on the TASK-20260801-022 snapshot alone. Return ADMISSIBLE or INADMISSIBLE with concrete defects. FOUR CHECKS DOMINATE. (1) THE NULL ARM NEVER TOUCHED THE REAL DATA - confirm STRUCTURALLY, from the archived package itself, that no half-tuple of the frozen deterministic factor base was enumerated, that the package contains no OBJ-REAL sample, no deterministic factor-base x-list and no statistic computed from one, and that the real-arm entry point was not invoked. This is ATS-1 clause 2 and you check it against the artifact, not against the contract's sentence. (2) THE DRIVER IS COMPLETE AND ITS REAL-ARM ENTRY POINT IS PRESENT AND UNEXECUTED - read the source, confirm the real-arm entry point exists and is reachable, and confirm from the stdout, the raw record and the command line that it was not called. (3) THE DRIVER HASH IS BOUND - recompute the sha256 of experiments/EXP-EQD-001/implementation/eqd001_driver.py yourself and confirm it equals both the value recorded in the calibration manifest and the DRIVER_SHA256 named in the TASK-20260801-022 snapshot receipt. A mismatch here means CTRL-EQD-DRIVER-HASH cannot be checked at the real arm at all. (4) THE MEASURED NULL NUMBERS ARE REPRODUCIBLE - regenerate a declared subset of the CAL-1 replicates from the recorded streams and seeds and confirm the archived statistic values, recompute the order statistics THR-EQD-1 will select from the archived replicate values, and recompute the CAL-2 detection rates and the CERT-EQD-1 certified-delta predicate. Report every recomputation as agreeing or disagreeing with a concrete number.
